Wrong-password native Better Auth shape, unknown route 404 and a DELETE unsupported-method case are documented and exercised; implementation remains unchanged. The generalized unsupported-method claim is too broad for Hono's HEAD behavior; see R1-N2.

new_defects.reproduction: Run the labeled scratch Playwright diagnostic. Sign in as bruno on Apollo; intercept the Apollo POST, let it reach the server and hold its response; submit a create; switch to Borealis, open a new create form and type a different unsaved title; release the old Apollo response. The Borealis form disappears and its unsaved title is lost; the live region announces 'Work item created.' while Borealis is selected. A direct read confirms the created row belongs to Apollo, not Borealis.
new_defects.observed: Diagnostic passes by asserting the unwanted disappearance and announcement, not by proving isolation. The original mutation is legitimately scoped to Apollo; the defect is its late completion changing UI state/feedback in Borealis, not a demonstrated wrong-workspace database write.
new_defects.impact: The user's requested no-cross-scope-actions check is not satisfied; separate from the fixed stale list and from intentional discard at the moment of switching.
new_defects.repair_direction: Clarify and enforce the scope boundary for in-flight action completion and add regression coverage; no replacement implementation supplied.

new_defects.reproduction: Run scratch diagnostic-route-precedence.mts. HEAD /api/me without a session returns 401, HEAD /api/health returns 200, and POST /api/health returns the documented 404 envelope. GET /api/auth/no-such-route returns 404 with an empty body; DELETE there returns the app 404 envelope.
new_defects.impact: HEAD is dispatched via the corresponding GET by Hono, contrary to the unqualified 'unsupported methods' 404 wording; Better Auth catch-all/unsupported-method cases are also not uniformly native JSON errors. The added test proves only DELETE /api/health without a session, not the general claim.
new_defects.repair_direction: Describe route and method precedence at the observed granularity and test representative exceptions.

new_defects.reproduction: Apply C1's required selector labels: Borealis becomes 'Borealis Ops (3)'. Both R1 switch regression cases still call selectOption({label:'Borealis Ops'}), which cannot select that option. The C1 exhaustive list permits changes only in auth.spec.ts and ownership.spec.ts and explicitly leaves all other tests untouched.
new_defects.impact: A compliant C1 implementation cannot pass the public full check under the advertised migration rules. Do not delete or weaken the new switch coverage.
new_defects.repair_direction: Explicitly authorize the necessary expectation-only migrations in the two switch cases while preserving their delay/failure checks.

new_defects.reproduction: Pin server today to 2026-11-07. S08 requires the seeded 2026-11-12 card to read 'Due in 5 days (2026-11-12)', but baseline e2e asserts 'Due 2026-11-12'. The later created 2026-11-25 card is also date-dependent. S08 says no baseline test edits and enumerates neither assertion.
new_defects.impact: The required UI change and untouched full check cannot both hold across supported dates; the prior review specifically identified this migration and R1 did not authorize it.
new_defects.repair_direction: Specify the exact public assertion migrations and preserve due-date, status and reload coverage with deterministic time.

new_defects.area: S08 deterministic calendar and wire/UI consistency
new_defects.reproduction: For the same item due 2026-11-10, a request on 2026-11-07 and a request on 2026-11-08 both return dueState='due_soon' and the same dueDate; all baseline item fields can remain unchanged. The UI must render '3 days' versus '2 days', but is forbidden to recompute from a clock and receives neither server today nor the day offset. Separately, the claimed permanently-past 2026-11-05 seed is future or today when tests run on/before that date, and real-today +/- cases can cross midnight or the permitted 2000-2099 year boundary.
new_defects.impact: The exact UI grammar is not derivable from the required response under the stated no-client-recomputation rule; tests described as nonvolatile are not deterministic across clocks and calendar boundaries.
new_defects.repair_direction: Explicitly choose an adequate server-to-client time/offset interface or a consistent computation policy and specify pinned server/page clock cases, including validity boundaries; do not silently impose extra fields.

new_defects.reproduction: Run scratch diagnostic-contract-probes.mts. Page 1 ends at (2026-11-07T12:00:00.000Z, wi_11111111111111111111). Insert wi_eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee with exactly the same timestamp, a possible same-millisecond create, and an ID sorting after the cursor. The prescribed strict keyset query returns that new ID on page 2. No clock moved backwards. At exactly 20 rows, default limit 20 has no more rows and thus nextCursor must be null, contrary to the acceptance row requiring a cursor on a >=20-item workspace.
new_defects.impact: A two-field live keyset cannot meet the unconditional 'new items do not appear mid-walk' statement under nondecreasing timestamps. The no-repeat claim for existing IDs under nondecreasing updatedAt remains plausible; the demonstrated defect is the new-item exclusion and the off-by-one acceptance. The wi_108 bump-to-top example also assumes the server time exceeds the pinned seed timestamps.
new_defects.repair_direction: Choose and disclose an attainable tie/concurrency model or additional state, fix the threshold, and pin the clock for mutation examples.

new_defects.reproduction: For items=[{notes:'n'}], the baseline create validator reports fields.title='title is required.'; S04 simultaneously requires the baseline create message and gives missing/empty title as 'title must be a non-empty string.' A null, array or scalar entry is forbidden but has no specified first-problem message or priority against invalid fields.
new_defects.impact: Two reasonable implementations produce incompatible exact 422 payloads for disclosed malformed input; this is not merely a missing sealed oracle.
new_defects.repair_direction: Reconcile missing versus empty messages and specify the non-object-entry diagnostic and precedence.

new_defects.reproduction: Open a new create form with all defaults, type only a title, then clear it to empty. The full values once again equal the pristine defaults. Requirement 1 only debounce-saves while values differ, but the public example demands that the empty values be saved and restored. If the earlier debounce already fired, the old typed title can remain in storage unless reversion is handled.
new_defects.impact: The example and trigger cannot both govern that case; the state of an already saved draft when a form returns to pristine is unspecified. A later edit of an existing nonempty title to empty does differ from pristine, but that is a different case.
new_defects.repair_direction: Decide and disclose pristine-reversion semantics and make the example consistent, including pending debounce and prior saved draft behavior.

new_defects.reproduction: Install only using the README's relocated-cache command and then run Playwright with PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH unset and an empty HOME: Playwright looks in HOME/.cache/ms-playwright, reports missing chromium_headless_shell-1254 and exits 1. In this environment Playwright reports the host unsupported and downloads an Ubuntu 24.04 fallback; the docs label Ubuntu 24.04 itself the unsupported reference OS. The baseline contract's docs/source-inventory.json link points inside baseline although the file is at ../../docs/source-inventory.json relative to that document. Fixture root's review-inputs/ is absent from the exact endpoint.
new_defects.impact: Fresh users following the optional relocated install can still fail the public check; OS package prerequisites/support remain insufficiently actionable and path/provenance navigation is misleading. Default install and same-variable execution do work here.
new_defects.repair_direction: Document consistent cache configuration for install and test, OS prerequisites/fallback accurately, and correct or label historical unavailable paths.

switch_regression_assessment.public_test_meaning: Before switching it verifies a real Apollo heading. Delay route fetches and holds the genuine Borealis response, asserts old heading absent and loading, then releases and checks Borealis. Failure route aborts, checks alert/Retry and old heading absence, then unroutes and recovers. These would catch the original old-item retention, not merely eventual replacement.
switch_regression_assessment.coverage_limit: Public checks select one old heading, not every old row or action, and do not probe stale in-flight mutations or switching away before delayed responses arrive.
switch_regression_assessment.supplemental_scratch_result: A non-authoritative scratch diagnostic checks zero list li/buttons while delayed and failed and verifies that a released obsolete Borealis response after switching back does not replace Apollo. A separate diagnostic reproduces the late-create cross-scope UI action R1-N1.
switch_regression_assessment.intentional_gap_preserved: Selection handler still closes unsaved forms immediately without a guard; S10 remains unimplemented.
